paragraphs: Orlo sells a community engagement platform for the public sector, bringing social media management, social media listening, media monitoring and surveying together with responsible AI. Orlo works with over 400 public sector organisations, including local government and central government, NHS trusts, charities, universities and the UK Police Force. The platform is set out in three areas: social media management, voice of the community, and customer service.

Social media management covers scheduling and posting to channels including Nextdoor, Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with analytics and a content calendar. Voice of the community combines surveys, social listening, consultations and media monitoring. Customer service handles resident enquiries through chatbots, live chat and a centralised inbox.

Orlo Insights builds on social listening and media monitoring with AI developed for the public sector. Orlo's trust indicator is described as measuring the driving factors of trust and distrust amongst citizens. Insights draws on sources reached through a partnership with LexisNexis, including online news sites, blogs and forums as well as print media.
